question: What information advantage might exist that this laboratory cannot currently observe?

advantages.name: Kline aggression / trade intensity (taker buy share, n_trades)
advantages.mechanism: Aggressive buyer share and trade count are bar-level microstructure state not recoverable from close-only transforms; previously discarded from Binance klines
advantages.partial_note: Columns retained on new fetch; characterize before LEDA map
advantages.reject_if: turned into another long/flat mom clone without characterization

advantages.name: Premium residual after funding (orthogonal leverage stress)
advantages.mechanism: Component of mark–index premium not explained by discrete funding prints
advantages.reject_if: fit residual on full sample without causal lag discipline

advantages.name: Perpetual mark–index premium (futures consensus vs spot)
advantages.mechanism: Funding/basis related but level of premium is distinct observation of futures positioning pressure
advantages.partial_note: corr vs funding ~0.68; role uncertainty not direction; LEDA not opened
advantages.reject_if: duplicate of funding-rate programmes without residual claim

advantages.name: Labeled exchange/ETF inventory (vendor-grade, non-revised)
advantages.mechanism: True tradable supply on venues and ETF pipes
advantages.partial_note: Free netflow conf-null; vendor PIT may differ

advantages.name: Price residual vs pre-event implied odds
advantages.mechanism: Under/over-reaction after resolution relative to market

advantages.name: Cross-event market-implied state (prediction market panel)
advantages.mechanism: Aggregated crowd probabilities across many events encode risk-on/off, policy, and path beliefs not in OHLCV alone
advantages.partial_note: Panel path tested null; further path panels low EV
advantages.reject_if: reverts to single popular binary without panel design

advantages.name: Options skew / vol risk premium
advantages.mechanism: Tail insurance pricing and dealer hedging flows

advantages.name: Macro liquidity / USD regime as conditioner
advantages.mechanism: Global risk appetite and USD strength shift crypto risk premia
advantages.partial_note: FRED DXY/DGS2 programme null as atomistic filters
advantages.reject_if: used as another technical overlay without economic lag story

advantages.name: Social narrative velocity with true timestamps
Another free daily on-chain metric (same family)

self_critique_seed: World-class group would prioritise missing information and multiplicity discipline over more engineering — hypothesis only.
